manifest.name: STARBOX COFFEE
manifest.description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. Version 2.2: a progressive Espresso climb and advanced Latte switchbacks. Circle the glass mug with Milo or Mira, master slippery ceramic and regenerating biscuits, collect your recipe and outrun rising coffee. Permanent timber detours and Perfect Coffee cards. Free arcade play.
